topic: How big the space station is
script: The International Space Station is about as long as a football field. It weighs more than 400,000 kilograms. It was built piece by piece, with parts from many countries. You can sometimes see it from the ground without a telescope. It looks like a bright star moving steadily across the sky. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
title: You Can See the Space Station Without a Telescope #ISS #SpaceFacts #Shorts
